use_when: To pick one option from two to five where each needs a line of detail, such as the rate ("Whole apartment · non refundable"), when to pay, or which saved card to use at checkout.
Use the trailing text for the price of each option, such as "484.00 EUR" or "0.00 EUR now"; turn it off when options have no price, such as payment methods.
Use state disabled for an option that exists but can't be picked right now, such as a sold-out rate, and say why in the description.

dont_use_when.when: For more than five options, or options with no detail: use a Dropdown.
To pick several options: use Checkboxes.
To switch a view, such as a time range: use Buttongroup type segmented.

placement: Stacked vertically in a radiogroup (the Group story, as in the Figma "Payment group").

a11y.fact: The control is a native <input type="radio">, so keyboard (Tab, arrow keys within a name group), focus and disabled behaviour are the browser's own; state="disabled" sets the real disabled attribute.
The whole card is one <label> around the input, so clicking anywhere on the card selects it and the title and description give it its accessible name.
The drawn radio is decorative (aria-hidden); checked state is carried by the native input.
